plugins.name: robot-md
plugins.description: Bounded physical-AI robotics plugin: live SO-ARM101 telemetry console (MCP App), robot_doctor fault isolation, ROBOT.md workspace checks, and castor-hal guidance.
suggestedPrompts: Open the Robot-MD Console side pane and check live SO-ARM101 bus telemetry
Run robot_doctor to check hardware reachability and servo voltages
Test whether (650, 0, 120) mm is inside the ROBOT.md workspace envelope

plugins.name: graftfork
plugins.description: Test-gated upstream fork carry assistant: interactive Carry Inspector MCP App, local fork status analysis, and GraftFork CLI/MCP workflow skills.
suggestedPrompts: Open the GraftFork Inspector side pane and check our fork carry status
Inspect my local git fork to see commits ahead of upstream and conflict risk
Check GraftFork's public benchmark results and test-gate rules
